name: one_block_per_row_warp_rmsnorm
hypothesis: A single 256-thread block per row removes the reference launch chain while retaining FP32 accumulation and fused normalization, scaling, and FP16 conversion.

kernel_strategy.reduction: warp shuffle reduction with shared warp sums
kernel_strategy.supported_hidden_size: arbitrary positive hidden_size; official fast path is H=1024

constraints: no allocation, synchronization, collective, residual, dropout, TE, or BDA behavior
x and weight are read-only; output is distinct
